title: feat(record-page): the field area is one list in the side preview, on a phone and in the pinned left column (#36147)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
Fixes #36147

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuSuiLqQhyEd4RmCmzfMdhFV)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWmyKFrcthV9y5wUiP

Part of epic #35590 (record page redo). One PR for the card. Claim 7066162109; Sales ruled "all as the card says" (7066516044).

Clause-②: yes (widening): `@object-ui/fields` exports a new `ReferenceChipContext` (a boolean React context, default `false`); `@object-ui/i18n` gains five keys in every pack (`detail.systemInfo`, `detail.createdTime`, `detail.updatedTime`, `detail.recordNumber`, `detail.clickToEdit`). No prop, export or schema key is removed or narrowed. The field-list context (`RecordFieldListContext`) is module-internal to `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, not in its barrel.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 抽屉、手机「详情」页签、宽屏钉住的左栏，字段区现在是同一个列表：一行一个字段，标签在左、值在右，行间细线；任何宽度都是一列。只有「整页且没有其他页签」的记录页仍按宽度多列。
- 分组标题在左，箭头在最右（收起朝下、展开朝上），整行可点。
- 查找字段显示成带对象颜色图标的标签，名字完整换行不截断；点标签打开那条记录，点同一行其他地方是编辑。
- 所有分组的空字段合成列表最后一行「显示 N 个空字段」，选择按对象记住。
- 「系统信息」是最后一个分组，默认收起（创建人、创建时间、修改人、修改时间、负责人〔正文没画时〕、记录编号）。**它在这个页面上替代了 objectui#12307 加的底部一行元信息**；别处那一行不变。
- 不再有铅笔：单击可编辑的值就进入编辑，不再需要双击；**只读值单击不再复制**（悬停或键盘聚焦时的复制图标还在）。
- 手机上原来的 iOS 分组卡片样式在这里去掉了，和抽屉一样的行；手机上只读值不再出现复制图标（长按选中文字）。
- 箭头只出现在对象声明为「可折叠」的分组上（字段分组默认不可折叠，CRM 的分组都是这样），默认分组不加箭头，不改元数据约定；「系统信息」总是可折叠。
- 桌面上能看到的变化：有其他页签的整页（例如商机，有产品明细等页签）「详情」从按宽度 3 列变成 1 列。

## What changes

All on the synthesized (default) record page's field area, which is `DetailSection`'s frameless face in all three places (side preview / split pane, phone 「详情」 tab, wide page's pinned left column). Authored record pages and every other `DetailView` keep their faces.

1. **One shared list, one column at any width (items 1, 2, 8).** `RecordPageColumns` now sets `DetailsColumnCapContext` to 1 everywhere except a full page whose details are its only face (no other tab, none hidden), which keeps 3. Under the cap of 1 the section draws one column of label-left rows with a hairline between them (`data-detail-section-list`). The phone's iOS grouped-inset branch no longer applies to the frameless face, so the phone draws the same rows. The phone's two-column highlights block was already gone on the default page (#35891); nothing is drawn in its place.
2. **Group title row (item 3).** Title left, chevron at the row's right end: `ChevronDown` folded, `ChevronUp` open; the whole row is the toggle (`aria-expanded`).
3. **Reference chips (item 4).** Inside the frameless section `ReferenceChipContext` is `true`, and `LookupCellRenderer`'s `ReferencedRecordLink` draws a pill: the referenced object's `ObjectIconTile` (`ObjectSchema.color` / `icon`, #35985) and the whole name, `break-words`, not truncated. It is still the same anchor (same `href`, same `openRecord` click, `stopPropagation`), so a click opens the record and is not the row's; with no route it is a plain pill. Outside the context the link face is unchanged.
4. **Empty fields in one last row (item 5).** Under the laid-out page each section hides its empty rows and reports the count to a per-page tally (`recordFieldList.ts`, the `recordBodyFields.ts` store pattern: `useId` + layout effect, read with `useSyncExternalStore`). `EmptyFieldsRow` closes the details column with 「显示 N 个空字段」 / 「隐藏空字段」. The choice is the existing per-object record-page preference `showEmptyFields` (#25883). This replaces, on this page only, each section's own toggle and `DetailView`'s 「N 个空分组」 line. An authored `hideEmpty` section stays hidden and is not counted; an all-empty group draws nothing until the reader shows empties.
5. **「系统信息」 last group (item 6).** Under the field list, `RecordMetaFooter` draws a folded `DetailSection` titled 系统信息 with one read-only row per fact: created by, created on, updated by and updated on (only when the record was updated), the owner (only when neither the strip nor the body draws it, the #28868 / #35941 owner-once rule unchanged) and the record ID. **This reverses objectui#12307's one-line meta footer on the laid-out record page**, as the card asks; outside the field list (print, embedded `DetailView`, authored pages) the line is unchanged. The group is wrapped so its rows do not report as body fields.
6. **Click to edit, no pencil (item 7).** On the frameless face a single click on an editable value calls `onEnterInlineEdit`, unless the click lands on a link, button, input or `role=button|link|checkbox` inside the value, or the reader has a text selection in the row. The pencil `Button` stays in the DOM as `sr-only` and shows on `focus-visible`, so keyboard users keep a way in; the title hint reads "Click to edit". Double-click is no longer wired there. The pencil, its tooltip and the value's title are named for the gesture that works there, `detail.clickToEdit` ("Click to edit" / 点击编辑); every other face keeps `detail.editInlineHint`. Read-only values no longer copy on click (`copyInteractive` is off for frameless). The copy icon stays for a mouse (hover / keyboard focus) and is `pointer-coarse:hidden` on the field list, so a phone shows no copy icon (ruling 1): a tap would otherwise set `:hover` and reveal it. An editable lookup: the chip opens the record (#36015 precedent), the rest of the row edits.

Dev-thread calls (no card needed under the 22:19Z rule):
- **Item 3 reads the authored contract.** The chevron and the whole-row toggle are drawn for a group that folds: a field group the object declares `collapse: 'collapsed' | 'expanded'`, and 系统信息. A field group's spec default is `collapse: 'none'` ("always open, no toggle"), so on CRM (商机, 其他) no group has an arrow. Making `none` groups foldable would override authored metadata, so it is not done here; that would be a separate question for the seat. A declared foldable group (showcase Semantic Zoo, 财务信息) is shown folded and open in the evidence comment.
- Items 3–7 apply to the whole default-page frameless face, including the multi-column full page with no other tabs, so the page has one behaviour.
- The empty-fields row sits after 系统信息, as the column's last row.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx` is not touched (#36151, #36149 + #36201 wait on this merge).

## Card checklist

- One shared field area for drawer / phone / pinned left column. ✔ (`DetailSection.fieldList-36147`, `RecordPageColumns.test.tsx` new describe)
- One column at any width; full page with no other tabs keeps multi-column. ✔ (cap tests at drawer / pinned / full-page-alone; browser: drawer 2→1, opportunity full page 3→1)
- Group chevron at the right, down folded / up open, whole row toggles. ✔
- Lookup values are object-colour chips; click opens the record. ✔ (`referenceChip-36147`; browser href)
- Empty fields in one collapsed last row. ✔ (count, toggle, withdraw on unmount, authored hide not counted, outside-list control)
- 系统信息 last, collapsed by default. ✔ (`RecordMetaFooter.systemInfo-36147`, control: outside the list the line is unchanged)
- No pencil; click edits; read-only takes no click. ✔ (unit + browser on desktop and iPhone 12 emulation)
- No two-column highlights on phone. ✔ (already none on the default page; the phone face is the same rows)

## Verification

- `vitest run packages/plugin-detail`: 406 files / 3,749 tests pass (18 skipped, existing), re-run after the L1-d rework. `vitest run packages/fields`: 321 files / 4,821 pass (7 skipped).
- App-shell and console tests that mount the record page (247 files picked by `RecordDetailView|RecordPageColumns|record-meta-footer|data-detail-field|…`): 2,092 / 2,099 passed first time; the 7 failures were the two owner-once files that read the meta line (`RecordDetailView.phoneOwnerLine-28909`, `RecordMetaFooter.ownerOnceBody-35941`). They now open 系统信息 and read its Owner / Record ID rows, with the same owner-once assertions; 9 / 9 pass.
- `type-check` (src and tests) clean for plugin-detail and fields; full `pnpm build` (console `tsc` included) passes; ESLint on every changed file: 0 errors; `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- E2E `record-flow-phone-targets` (CI E2E UI) now reads the pencil classes from the module constants `PENCIL_CLASS` / `FIELD_LIST_PENCIL_CLASS` instead of a JSX attribute pattern, and gains one test: on a 375 px touch screen the field list's pencil is 1×1 px until a keyboard focuses it, then drawn at its size (6 / 6 pass locally; the new one failed before the class was given explicit `h-px w-px`).
- Live e2e `inline-edit-polish-2572` (not in the CI live list) is updated from double-click to click and the "Click to edit" hint. `read-only-member-record` and `RecordDetailView.harness` count pencils by name and now accept the field list's click name; the admin control counts the `sr-only` pencil instead of asking it to be visible.
- Browser (examples/app-crm, zh-CN): before / after shots of the drawer at 768 / 1024 / 1440 windows, the opportunity full page at 1440, the account's pinned left column at 1440 (also with 系统信息 opened), and the phone at 375 are in the project thread. A single click or tap on 金额 opens its editor; a click or tap on a read-only value does nothing; read-only values are `user-select: auto` with no click or touch handler, so the phone's native long-press selection applies. **NOT MEASURED on a physical phone:** that long-press selects a read-only value (ruling 1) was checked only by source (no handler, no `select-none`) and in emulation; it is owed to the first hosted phone reading.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; lint passes on the changed files.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset (`.changeset/36147-record-field-list.md`), and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's summary, in the maintainer's language).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
